جننتن (form I)
# جَنَنْتُنَّ (janantunna) /d͡ʒa.nan.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of جَنَّ (janna)
# جُنِنْتُنَّ (junintunna) /d͡ʒu.nin.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of جَنَّ (janna) and جُنَّ (junna)
